body.text: [AI-Applied] Fixed in auth.py, app.py, database.py: removed hardcoded secret literals and load them from the runtime environment. auth.py JWT_SECRET now os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] (was 'secret123'); removed hardcoded app.secret_key='secret123' in app.py (SECRET_KEY sourced from os.environ); database.py DB_PASSWORD now required from os.environ (removed insecure 'postgres' default fallback). No plaintext secret fallback remains for these values.
